rows.note: Use this when the item actually contains added cream, rather than merely having a creamy taste or texture.

example.english: This coffee is creamy because cream has been added.
example.traditional: 呢杯咖啡係加咗忌廉嘅，飲落好滑。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 hai6 gaa1 zo2 gei6 lim1 ge3 jam2 lok6 hou2 waat6

rows.note: Use this for a liquid whose consistency is thick, especially when its taste is not the focus.

example.english: This sauce is creamy and not easy to pour.
example.traditional: 呢支醬汁杰身，唔容易倒出嚟。
